yieldResolution.trigger: Yield timer ending; one persisted decision per yield episode, never an ordinary Observe tick
yieldResolution.probabilities: D + U + S = 1; U = (1 - D) * K; S = (1 - D) * (1 - K). K is conditional knockout chance among survivors.
yieldResolution.health: Meaningful injury health at expiry including healing, not the artificial defeated-health clamp
yieldResolution.constraints: For death-eligible NPCs D(0)=1, U(0)=S(0)=0; death increases as health falls and exceeds unconscious chance near zero. Nonlinear curve constants remain undecided.
yieldResolution.sampling: One r in [0,1): r<D selects death; D<=r<D+U selects unconscious; otherwise survival.
yieldResolution.persistence: Record outcome before effects; repeat updates and save/load resume it without rerolling. Rescue/healing, Surrender, Kneel or Death cancels pending expiry.
yieldResolution.compatibility: Current recovery-timer handler remains documented separately until this replacement is implemented.

boundPosture.standing: KneelingBound --Stand (On your feet.)--> StandingBound: stand-up first, then standing-bound entry/idle.
boundPosture.kneeling: StandingBound --Kneel (On your knees.)--> KneelingBound: kneeling entry first, then bound-kneeling entry/idle.
boundPosture.invariants: No unbound intermediate phase; binding/pacification and frozen wander budget retained. Restart hold at 1800 real seconds on posture command acceptance, not again at animation completion. Hold counts during choreography. Follow/Stay preserve remaining time. Death/release/expiry invalidates choreography.
boundPosture.codeGap: Current held phases ignore Kneel, and Stand/StandingBound are unimplemented. Ordered animation completion and failure handling require qualification.

yieldSurrender.routing: Yielding --Surrender--> AvoidingCombat if nearby combat active, otherwise Wandering.
yieldSurrender.effects: End defeat protection without potion or added healing; cancel pending yield outcome; begin unbound peaceful movement with configured rescued wander budget. No 1800-second hold.
yieldSurrender.codeGap: No Surrender native dialogue topic/action exists; current Rescue heals and On your knees. enters Kneeling. Reuse defeat-to-peaceful handoff with separate no-heal command routing.
